review_contract.goal: Preserve both branches' evidenced intent during a risky merge.
observed_failures: The agent started a merge without checking topology.
The agent guessed which branch intent should win.
The agent committed while conflicts or required checks remained.
normative_constraints: Analysis-only work must not mutate the repository.
Execution must not discard or auto-stash unrelated local work.

mandatory_blocks.name: topology and non-mutating preview
mandatory_blocks.effect: prevents mutation in an invalid merge state

mandatory_blocks.name: formal postcondition artifact for every interaction
mandatory_blocks.effect: forces a named intermediate artifact even when intent is obvious

mandatory_blocks.name: six-field final report
mandatory_blocks.effect: standardizes all reports regardless of task size

mandatory_blocks.name: no commit with unresolved conflicts or failed required checks
